issues.detail: The Hebrew 'יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול' means 'right or left' (both directions), but the Chinese renders 'שְׂמֹאול' as '左手' (left hand), which is a mistranslation of the directional term 'left' into a body part, changing the meaning from 'turn aside to the right or left' to 'turn aside to the right or left hand'.
